breakdown.description: The setup uses C3D20R elements, but the deck uses C3D6 elements.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification instructs to populate c3d6.inp 'exactly with the provided Input deck content, without any modifications to element type.' This means the C3D6 element type from the input deck is preserved, correctly ignoring the erroneous instruction to use C3D20R elements.

breakdown.description: The setup assumes that the primary nodal load acts in the global z-direction, but the deck applies the concentrated load in the global x-direction.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification instructs to populate c3d6.inp 'without any modifications to... load direction,' meaning the concentrated loads in the x-direction (direction 1) from the input deck are preserved, correctly ignoring the erroneous instruction that the load acts in the global z-direction.
